title: Conditionnel & past conditional
summary: Present conditional: infinitive + -ais… (je voudrais). Past conditional: conditionnel of avoir/être + participle (j'aurais dû). Used for polite requests, advice, regrets.
full_explanation: Present conditional: infinitive + -ais… (je voudrais). Past conditional: conditionnel of avoir/être + participle (j'aurais dû). Used for polite requests, advice, regrets. Learn meanings before drilling forms. Say each example aloud. Contrast English word order with French when helpful. Reuse the same lemmas in reading, dialogue, and exercises. Avoid story-memory quizzes — test forms and meanings only. When unsure, reopen the Words to learn first list in the lesson brief. Register matters: vous with strangers, tu with friends who offered it. Silent letters and liaison appear often; listen and repeat. Spiral earlier tools into new sentences.
